newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-LAST MINUTE EQUALISER DENIES ALBANIA RARE VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAST MINUTE EQUALISER DENIES ALBANIA RARE VICTORY.

text.p: Hakob Ter-Petrosyan denied Albania what would have been a rare World Cup victory when he scored a last minute goal to give Armenia a 1-1 draw in their group nine World Cup qualifier on Saturday.

Ter-Petrosyan, who came on as a substitute at the start of the second half, scored with the home crowd urging the referee to blow the final whistle for what would have been only Albania's fifth victory in 45 World Cup qualifiers since they first competed in 1964.
The goal arose from a cross from Varazdat Avetisyan. Goalkeeper Blendi Nallbani failed to hold it properly and the ball fell to Ter-Petrrosyan who fired into an empty net.
Bajram Fraholi had put the home side ahead with a close-range effort after 58 minutes following good work by Altin Rraklli down the right.
Albania went close in the first half when Altin Haxhi hit the bar in the 30th minute and Bledar Kola nearly scored with a powerful shot for Albania in the 69th minute.
The result means Albania, who have won only three World Cup qualifiers in the last 16 years, stay bottom of the group standings with one point from their opening two matches.
All the teams in the group were playing Saturday with Portugal meeting Ukraine and Germany playing Northern Ireland.

Albania: Blendi Nallbani; Rudi Vata, Arjan Xhumba, Saimir Malko, Artan Vila, Bledar Kola (Ilir Shulku 83), Bajram Fraholli, Viktor Paco (Ilir Alliu 46), Altin Haxhi, Altin Rraklli (Indrid Fortuzi 66), Fatmir Vata.

Armenia: Armenak Petrossian, Ervand Soukiassian, Vardan Khachatryan, Sargis Hovsepyan, Arsen Avetisyan (Hakob Ter-Petrosyan 46), Harytyun Vardarryan (Varazdat Avetisyan 72), Artur Petrosyan, Aramais Tonoyan (Vardan Minasyan 46), Hamlet Mkhitaryan, Eric Roland Assadourian, Karapet Mikalyan.
